items.text: Thank you to the folks from the PA Association of Community Health Centers for stopping by this week! The PACHC serves over a million Pennsylvanians annually, and it was great to talk about how we can work together to keep NEPA healthy. https://t.co/VhQ5AtDAaL

After more than three long years, Marc Fogel’s reprehensible confinement by Russia has come to an end. His wrongful detention in a Russian prison has been a strain on his health, his family, and his loved ones. 

Last month, I joined my Pennsylvania colleagues in a letter to Secretary of State Marco Rubio urging the State Department to prioritize Marc’s release. 

I am grateful to President Trump and his Administration for fulfilling their promise, and today, Pennsylvania is thrilled to welcome Marc Fogel home.

This morning, we visited PA08’s local VA Medical Center in Wilkes-Barre for a tour of their facilities. We discussed how we can work together for our veterans, including through the Simplifying Forms for Veterans Claims Act, which I introduced last week to support our nation’s past and present soldiers and their families. Thank you, VA Wilkes-Barre for showing us around!

Tonight’s vote was just a procedural step to start federal budget negotiations and does NOT change any current laws. I will fight to protect working-class families in Northeastern Pennsylvania and stand with President Trump in opposing gutting Medicaid. My position on this has not and will not change.

Great meeting with Pocono Mountains United Way President Michael Tukeva and Housing Initiatives Director Thomas Campbell! Looking forward to working together to tackle the housing shortage and improve education, financial stability, and health in Monroe County. Exciting things ahead!

Had a meaningful discussion with Allied Health Services about the challenges in long-term healthcare and the steps we’re taking to support our nurses and elderly, two groups that are absolutely vital to the well-being of Northeastern Pennsylvania. Grateful for the work they do every day to care for our community.

On National Nurses Day, we recognize our nurses and the critical care and compassion they offer patients at every stage of life, from the ER to care facilities to home health. Our nurses make a real and lasting difference in the lives of countless families in NEPA – thank you! https://t.co/V9ubyhrscQ
Wishing President Biden strength and resilience as he faces this health challenge. Our thoughts are with him and his family as he takes on this fight.

From helping veterans receive the benefits they earned, to resolving Social Security and Medicare issues, to cutting through red tape with the IRS and passport services, our office is delivering real results. Our team shows up every day with one goal in mind: helping the people of Northeast Pennsylvania.
From the start, I have said I would protect Medicaid benefits for my constituents who rely on them, and I am proud to fulfill that promise.

Francene, our Outreach Director, and Caroline, our new summer intern attended the MOM-n-PA free dental clinic. This event provides free dental care by local professionals to individuals who cannot afford dental treatment. https://t.co/LZ8xSINMVs

I spoke with Bill O’Boyle about why I voted to secure the border, cut taxes, invest in American workers, protect Medicaid, and strengthen our national defense. This legislation puts the needs of our country and PA-08 families first. Read the full article here ⬇️
https://t.co/91u6YsNfOi

For six decades, Medicare has provided vital health care coverage to millions of seniors, including thousands right here in NEPA. Here's to protecting and strengthening this critical program for generations to come. https://t.co/n2xUGKsxRe
Today on World Mental Health Day, we recognize that mental health is just as important as physical health. Everyone deserves access to the care and support they need. https://t.co/aFUUElS8vI

Visited the Geisinger Commonwealth School of Medicine’s Medical Sciences Building, grateful to see future physicians preparing to serve our communities. Proud to support institutions advancing healthcare, research, and medical education. https://t.co/pnauYQpII2

Every woman deserves a fair shot at early detection. The Find It Early Act removes cost barriers to lifesaving breast cancer screenings, because your health shouldn’t depend on your coverage plan. https://t.co/aaKGXkiQDu
Wishing everyone a bright and joyful Diwali! May this Festival of Lights bring happiness, health, and prosperity to you and your loved ones. https://t.co/kRFnvuGrpR
When it comes to breast cancer, time matters. The Access to Breast Cancer Diagnosis Act ensures cost is never a barrier to timely, life-saving care. https://t.co/B0qpg2IUiC

Millions of hardworking Americans are being hit with higher premiums because of short-sighted Democratic decisions. These were COVID-era tax credits that Democrats set to expire, and they’ve failed to lower the cost of healthcare. Without real, meaningful reform, healthcare will only keep getting more expensive. When the government reopens, we’re ready to fight for solutions that protect families and lower costs, but I will not do that while Democrats hold the federal government hostage.

Today we toured Lackawanna College in Scranton to see firsthand their growing programs in trades, technology, and healthcare. It’s inspiring to see how Lackawanna is expanding opportunity and preparing students for good-paying jobs across NEPA. https://t.co/S7jvy2IU8j

I am encouraged by this positive step toward ensuring the continuity of care for our community. These hospitals are essential to Scranton and the broader region, not only as providers of critical health services, but as major employers and anchors of our local economy.

My team and I will continue to work closely with all local, state, and federal leaders involved to help bring this agreement across the finish line and ensure that quality, accessible care remains available to everyone in Northeastern Pennsylvania.

https://t.co/tJOYmntIMc

A metastatic breast cancer diagnosis is a medical emergency, not a moment for red tape. This bill ensures patients get the care they need without waiting months for help that can’t wait. https://t.co/TddEJ5EIEn
Women and children who rely on WIC shouldn’t be pawns in the government shutdown. We need to protect nutrition support for millions of moms and kids and reopen the government.

Last week, we visited Maternal and Family Health Services in Scranton to tour their Circle of Care and discuss the vital role of WIC. Programs like WIC are lifelines for women, children, and families, and I’m committed to ensuring they remain funded and accessible.

Today’s vote was an easy call. Our government needed to reopen, because working people shouldn’t have to pay the price when Washington can’t get its act together. I’m ready to roll up my sleeves and work with anyone to make healthcare easier to afford, lower the cost of living, and deliver real results for the folks who keep Northeastern Pennsylvania running.
